title: Image-based analysis of lymphoma cell heterogeneity: Comparative study of CRYO and FFPE techniques

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Image-based analysis of lymphoma cell heterogeneity: Comparative study of CRYO and FFPE techniques》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-1】Lymphomas comprise a diverse group of heterogeneous cell malignancies, primarily diagnosed through morphological and histochemical analysis of tissue biopsy specimens.

evidence.text: Lymphomas comprise a diverse group of heterogeneous cell malignancies, primarily diagnosed through morphological and histochemical analysis of tissue biopsy specimens.

sections.title: 研究方法
sections.text:
《Image-based analysis of lymphoma cell heterogeneity: Comparative study of CRYO and FFPE techniques》：方法与研究设计的原文依据。

【Abstract · abstract-1-3】In the current study, we used deep learning-based approaches, namely a pre-trained StarDist model, a custom-trained StarDist model, and DeepLabV3, for automated nuclear segmentation of heterogeneous lymphoma cells in histological sections and achieved high accuracy of nuclear segmentation.

【Abstract · abstract-1-4】DeepLabV3 achieved the highest pixel-level segmentation accuracy when trained on large annotated datasets, whereas StarDist demonstrated greater data efficiency under limited training conditions.

evidence.text: In the current study, we used deep learning-based approaches, namely a pre-trained StarDist model, a custom-trained StarDist model, and DeepLabV3, for automated nuclear segmentation of heterogeneous lymphoma cells in histological sections and achieved high accuracy of nuclear segmentation.
DeepLabV3 achieved the highest pixel-level segmentation accuracy when trained on large annotated datasets, whereas StarDist demonstrated greater data efficiency under limited training conditions.
